user.title: Scene Priority
user.description: Manage Home Assistant scenes with per-device priority locks (0 = unset/lowest; 1 = highest, 2 next, etc.).

set_priority.title: Set Scene Priority
set_priority.description: Assign a priority (0 = unset/lowest; 1 = highest, then 2, 3...). Any >0 priority overrides 0.

remove_priority.title: Remove Scene Priority
remove_priority.description: Reset a scene back to default priority 0 (unset).

activate.name: Activate scene with priority
activate.description: Push a scene onto its target devices' priority locks. Priority 1 is highest, followed by 2, 3, etc.; 0 means unset (lowest).

scene_entity_id.name: Scene
scene_entity_id.description: The Home Assistant scene entity to activate.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: Priority level (1 is highest, 2 next, ...; 0 = unset/lowest).

transition.name: Transition
transition.description: Transition time in seconds passed to scene.turn_on.

release.name: Release scene from locks
release.description: Remove a scene from all device priority locks and automatically apply the next-highest scene remaining on each device, if any.

scene_entity_id.name: Scene
scene_entity_id.description: The Home Assistant scene entity to release.

transition.name: Transition
transition.description: Transition time in seconds when falling back to a lower scene.

clear.name: Clear priority locks
clear.description: Remove all device priority locks without applying any scene.
